craft_notes: Sthāyin: ascent ladder. Rows: stations climb. Read aloud: rising release.

lines: The Blest, when his time ends, mounting drop, half-moon, checked,
melts in hum; hum in Might; that in the All-spread; she in the Unheld.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sadāśivaḥ svakālaparikṣaye bindvardhacandranirodhikā ākramya nāde līyate nādaḥ śaktitattve tat vyāpinyāṃ sā ca anāśrite
